subject: Renewal: SOC 2 recert + retention window coordination
messages:
From: Alice Choi <alice.choi@brightbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Procurement <security+procurement@brightbank.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Renewal: SOC 2 recert + retention window questions

Hi Sofia,

We're beginning our renewal planning and need to confirm Redwood's SOC 2 recert timeline and the proposed change to audit log retention. Specifically:

- Can you confirm you can extend log retention from 90 days to 365 days for our account by July 31? We need chain-of-custody for token logs and access audit trails.
- We'll likely need a bulk export of application logs (approx 400GB monthly) and a daily snapshot for 30 days during recert. Is there an export playbook?
- We are also evaluating increasing dedicated capacity during the evidence transfer window; what would a short-term 2x burst look like for throughput and pricing?

We'd like a mutual action plan (timeline + deliverables) and a single point of contact for evidence handoff to our internal auditors.

Thanks,
Alice Choi
Security & Procurement
BrightBank
Attachment: none (will accept Redwood playbook or links)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Choi <alice.choi@brightbank.com>
Cc: BrightBank Procurement <security+procurement@brightbank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 recert + retention window questions

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We're able to support a 365-day log retention for your account and can stage a bulk export cadence to support your auditors. Proposed next steps:

1) Mutual action plan: see attached 'recert-playbook-v1.pdf' (stub) — includes milestones, required artifacts, and ownership.
2) Evidence transfer: we'll provision a temporary export pipeline and recommend a 48–72 hour rolling snapshot for the first 30 days. Need exact expected monthly volume (you mentioned ~400GB) so we can size bandwidth.
3) Dedicated capacity burst: we can create a short-term 2x throughput bump for the evidence window; estimate incremental cost + onboarding for export nodes. Kimberly (cc'd) will confirm pricing and any available renewal credits.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff this week — proposed times Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: recert-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, stub)

Team — forwarding BrightBank's asks. Key points:

- They want 365d retention by 2026-07-31 and a bulk export playbook for ~400GB/mo and 30-day daily snapshots during recert.
- Opportunity to upsell a short-term 2x throughput bump for evidence transfer. Ask: can we offer 2 dedicated export nodes for 6 weeks? Ben — can you give ballpark pricing and whether we can attach a 10% renewal credit if they commit to 12 months post-renewal?
- Kimberly — legal will need an addendum for retention change + DocuSign. Also confirm whether SOC2 attestation timing (we'll include language that final attestation expected by 2026-07-31 if audit window completes on schedule).

I'll take point on the operational plan and provide the export runbook. Suggest we present a single-sheet M.A.P. and pricing options.

Sofia

Quick read — sounds straightforward.

Pricing options (ballpark):
- 2x short-term throughput bump (6 weeks): ~$9,000 total (includes export nodes + egress allowance). Can include a 10% promotional credit (~$900) if they sign a 12-month renewal commitment for Dedicated capacity.
- If they want continuous 365d retention as a permanent tier, that's a different SKU — estimate +$1,500/month recurring.

I'll draft a pricing sheet and MAP language; suggest we present both 'time-limited burst' and 'permanent retention' options.

Ben
